description: This file defines a series of React components related to user input, including a customizable Input component, a SearchInput variant with search functionalities, and a NumberInput for numeric values. It includes styling, animations, and accessibility features.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Main input component with animated label, icons, validation states, and visual effects.

methods.name: SearchInput
methods.description: A specialized input component for search functionality with a magnifying glass icon and clear button.

methods.name: NumberInput
methods.description: An input component tailored for numeric input with increment and decrement buttons.
